heading: Troubleshooting, TILs, case studies & postmortems
blurb: Written up as they happen. Troubleshooting is the specific fix; TILs are the small things picked up day to day; case studies and postmortems are the long form.

tabs.label: Troubleshooting
tabs.intro: Specific failures and the path to the actual cause — including the wrong turns. Written up whenever something takes more than an hour to work out.

tabs.label: TIL
tabs.intro: Today I Learned. Small things picked up day to day — a flag, a default, a behaviour that surprised me. One paragraph is a complete post.

tabs.label: Case studies
tabs.intro: Problem, the constraints I didn't choose, what I did, what it cost, and what I'd reverse today.

tabs.label: Postmortems
tabs.intro: Blameless. Timeline, contributing factors, what changed afterwards. Employers anonymised.

tabs.label: Blog
tabs.intro: Shorter pieces — things I've been reading, tools I've tried, opinions I'm still testing.
